ruling.recommended_action: Route to Ryde Trust & Safety for manual review; preserve the in-app chat log (F3–F5) and driver statement (F6); contact the rider via RydeHELP to take a statement; review the driver's account for Code of Conduct action and record the outcome. No automated fare ruling is issued.
ruling.reasoning: Safety screen (SAFE-1) is dispositive. The dispute type is safety, and the chat record contains the driver's own message at 17:10: "Sit down or I lock the doors." [F4] Read in context — the rider had just asked to stop and get out [F3] — this is an intimidation/restriction-of-movement statement and, at minimum, hostile and abusive language aimed at the rider, which Ryde's code of conduct bars ("abuse of any kind", "Threats and Intimidation"). Consonant with the escalation rule, the driver's written statement repeats that he "told her to sit down for her own safety and drove on" after the rider tried to open the door [F6]. Either way, the record shows an alleged confinement threat and a rider-held fear of harm; this is not for an automated ruling. Per SAFE-1 I do not decide the merits: ruling = escalate, safety_concern = "suspected" (wording is in the record; whether it satisfies the Code of Conduct threshold is for a human reviewer). SAFE-2 is not invoked — no collision, injury or dangerous-driving allegation is in the record. Route/fare: actual 15.4 km vs optimal 15.5 km (-0.1 km, -0%) [F1] shows no off-route segment and no detour, so no RD-2 refund is in play, and the +1.9 min duration [F2] is within traffic noise; nothing here changes the outcome or would warrant a flag on route/no-show grounds. Profiles [F7][F8] show zero prior disputes and are not used to decide anything. Because the case is escalated, flag_account is not set by me. Evidence status: sufficient for the safety screen (every chat message is timestamped [F5], and the record settles what is needed to route the case); the fare/route elements are complete but the routing decision is intentionally deferred to a human, so no further step is output.
ruling.escalation_reason: Dispute type is safety and the chat record contains an intimidation/lock-in statement by the driver directed at the rider [F4], corroborated by the rider's complaint and the driver's own statement [F6]. SAFE-1 requires escalation without an automated ruling; the wording's severity and the driver's account are for a human reviewer.

rejected_claims.reason: Actual distance 15.4 km vs optimal 15.5 km (-0.1 km, -0%) [F1] shows no off-route segment; no detour refund arises. Moot given the safety escalation.
No cancellation or add-on fee is disputed; trip was completed and no waiting/extra charge appears in the record.

The driver's statement that he acted 'for her own safety' [F6] is a claim, not a fact; it does not neutralize a lock-in threat made to a rider asking to exit and is a matter for the human reviewer under SAFE-1.

safety_basis: Chat #2 17:10 driver: "Sit down or I lock the doors." [F4] — intimidation/restriction of movement aimed at the rider after she asked to stop and get out [F3]
Driver statement [F6]: "I told her to sit down for her own safety and drove on" — confirms the driver continued the trip after the rider tried to exit and was told to sit down
Rider complaint: "The driver threatened to lock me in when I asked to get out. I felt unsafe for the whole ride."
